remarks: * Sunday 3/22 open house cancelled * Tucked at the end of a quiet North Stamford cul-de-sac on a desirable corner lot, this beautifully maintained four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath colonial delivers the kind of lifestyle buyers are searching for. A short stroll to the Stamford Nature Center, approximately one mile to Trader Joe's and local shopping, and just minutes to the Merritt Parkway, the location strikes the perfect balance between privacy and accessibility. Inside, you'll find sun-filled living spaces, central air throughout, a finished basement ideal for entertaining or flexible use, a full attic for additional storage, and a spacious two-car garage. A dedicated laundry and mudroom off the garage with newer washer and dryer adds everyday convenience. Major updates include a newer roof in 2015 and HVAC system in 2021, offering true peace of mind. With natural gas, public water, and the potential to connect to city sewer, this is a rare North Stamford offering that truly checks every box.
